scope: Selected A/B byte candidates for documented NECA editions; no canon/human/runtime validation

limitations: Source-scoped NECA2016 Concrete Jungle toy edition, not certified original game geometry.
The mask occupies a small part of the960x1200 and1003x1200 catalogue photographs; fine relief and wear texture are interpretations, not1:1 microdetail proof.
Only the primary photograph’s inclined camera is referenced; hidden back, interior and side geometry remain unknown.
The unmasked head inset, cranial peak, chin, dreadlocks, cannon and body/armour are excluded.
Native visible minimum margin is below requested8–12percent; full mask remains within frame. No CPU resizing or pixel editing performed.
entries.sourceEdition: NECA2016 licensed toy adaptation of Predator:Concrete Jungle; not certified original game geometry

limitations: Specific NECA2016 Series16 Stalker Kenner tribute toy edition, not LostTribeStalker or a certified original film mask.
Only primary photograph shows a complete worn mask; support blister partly hides the accessory bottom and cannot establish another full camera.
Small source mask region about200px tall; fine relief, exact UV/albedo, hidden sides/back/interior are not established.
Translucent ivory material belongs to the biological wearer/dreadlocks; no sufficient evidence that opaque bronze shell is translucent.
A is a new ImageGen isolation, not exact photo pixels or a manual alpha cutout; B is a separate rendering adaptation, not certified PHG mesh/material.
Very low-alpha native edge pixels are preserved without CPU cleaning; maximum border alpha is recorded.
Native transparent margins are slightly tighter than the requested8-12percent at one edge; the complete solid mask remains unclipped and exact bounds are recorded.
entries.sourceEdition: NECA Stalker Kenner tribute,Series16,2016,7-inch; distinct from LostTribe Stalker

limitations: PHG material/light restaging of the photographed NECA Ultimate2017 mask, not a canonical comic certification.
Minute pitting, tiny grooves and small source-camera straightening are interpreted.
Upper inner-U metallic ridges are supported by both photos; separate beige biological teeth are excluded and the aperture remains alpha-empty.
